about_blocks.text: Addictions services consist of intervention, support counselling, referrals to detox and residential treatment education and prevention activities in school and community settings. The Counselling team provides confidential emotional support and promote positive growth and healing for individual adults, children, youth and families. This includes crisis response, short term and long term counselling services. The Counselling service also provides some outreach to communities at the north end of the lake and educational programs in community settings.
